method: Read-only inspection of the installed Arc arm64 executable; independent palette calculation using the previously retrieved MIT ColorThiefSwift reference.

confirmedCallPath.meaning: Live SearchEngineClient construction; stores the site-search publisher closure at struct offset 0x38.
Closure thunk forwards to 0x102208854 with captured ADKClient and scheduler.
Constructs ArcHistoryQueryOptions, sets searchText from caller arguments, sets maxResults=1, maps results and switches to the latest publisher.
Takes the first history result URL. Missing result or URL produces a nil Just publisher.
Invokes ADKClient._favicon at offset 0x200 for the result URL, then compactMaps through the site-search color routine.
Calls 0x10097034c with quality=10, ignoreWhite=true, minimum brightness=0.15; converts RGB to NSColor and invokes 0x1009a9be4 with 0.15.
Extracts native CGImage pixels, quantizes to five colors, chooses the first palette color whose HSV brightness is at least 0.15; falls back to the first color if none pass.
Obtains HSL through 0x1009a9574, subtracts 0.15 from lightness, clamps to [0,1], preserves hue/saturation/alpha and reconstructs in the original color space.

implications: The live site-search fallback does not directly use the bundled search engine icon. A history lookup precedes favicon extraction.
Favicon database presence alone does not guarantee the fallback emits a color; missing matching history can leave the previous scope color retained.
The general favicon fetcher quality=5 routine identified earlier is not the same call used by site search.
